caseName: Serbian Orthodox Church Congregation of St. Demetrius v. Kelemen
caseNameFull: SERBIAN ORTHODOX CHURCH CONGREGATION OF ST. DEMETRIUS OF AKRON v. KELEMEN
attorneys: Bernard R. Roetzel and Bernard J. Roetzel for petitioner., Frederick H. Gillen and Don R. Miller for respondents.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The petition for a writ of certiorari is granted, judgment is vacated, and the case is remanded to the Supreme Court of Ohio for further consideration in light of Presbyterian Church in the United States v. Mary Elizabeth Blue Hull Memorial Presbyterian Church, ante, p. 440.
